entries.d6d184fb3987bbb1: The medium-term management plan 'United for Growth 2027,' covering fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2027, sets as its basic policies 'Deepening Governance,' 'Further Strengthening of Growth Areas' and 'Establishing New Challenge Areas.' The company says it will focus on further strengthening its competitive advantage in growth areas such as chocolate fats (CBE) and compound chocolate, and on developing challenge areas that will become new business pillars. The group's vision is: 'Pursuing deliciousness and health through plant-based materials, and co-creating a sustainable future of food.'
entries.e570525c9a2f2428: The company earns revenue from sales of food materials. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥772,288 million, up 15.1% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. The main factor was higher selling prices accompanying higher procurement prices for key raw materials such as palm oil and cacao beans.
